clauses.heading: Voice and style
clauses.text: Write in a calm, warm and plain voice. Speak to the reader as "you" and avoid hype.

clauses.heading: Voice and style
clauses.text: Do not write words fully in capital letters for emphasis. Approved acronyms such as SPF, UV and INR are allowed.

clauses.heading: Voice and style
clauses.text: Use at most one exclamation mark in a piece of content, and never two in a row.

clauses.heading: Voice and style
clauses.text: Keep sentences under 30 words so they are easy to read on a phone.

clauses.heading: Names
clauses.text: Always use the full approved product name, exactly as listed in the product fact sheet. Do not shorten or rename products.

clauses.heading: Names
clauses.text: Write the brand name as Northfern, with a capital N and no space.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Do not describe any product as a miracle, magic, instant or a cure, or use similar language that promises results beyond what is tested.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Northfern products are cosmetics. Do not claim that any product treats, heals, clears or prevents a medical condition such as eczema, acne or psoriasis.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Do not say a product is dermatologist recommended, clinically proven or clinically tested unless that exact claim is listed as approved in the product fact sheet.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Do not compare Northfern products with competitors, criticise other brands, or claim to be better than other brands.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Do not use fear-based language about skin, such as calling skin ugly, ruined, damaged beyond repair or embarrassing.

clauses.heading: Claims
clauses.text: Do not promise guaranteed or permanent results, or results within a time that is not in the approved fact sheet.

clauses.heading: Prices and offers
clauses.text: Prices must match the current price in the approved fact sheet and be written with the rupee symbol, for example ₹549.

clauses.heading: Prices and offers
clauses.text: Do not announce discounts, offers or free gifts unless the offer is listed in the approved fact sheet.

clauses.heading: Disclosure and inclusion
clauses.text: Every paid or gifted creator post must start with #ad or #sponsored.

clauses.heading: Disclosure and inclusion
clauses.text: Do not suggest that one skin tone or skin type is better than another. Never use words such as fairness, whitening or lightening.

rules.message: Hype words promise results beyond what is tested.
These words suggest one skin tone is better than another.
Results cannot be guaranteed or permanent.
Write the brand name as Northfern.
Use at most one exclamation mark.
Shorter sentences are easier to read on a phone.
Paid or gifted creator posts must be disclosed.
